title: What happens to your brain after 10 hours alone?
description:
What happens to your brain after ten hours with no social contact? In a brain imaging study, people who were isolated showed a craving-like response in the midbrain when they saw pictures of people together, similar to the response to food after fasting.

Source: Tomova et al., 2020, Nature Neuroscience ("Acute social isolation evokes midbrain craving responses similar to hunger").

#shorts #psychology #loneliness

scenes.headline: 10 HOURS ALONE
scenes.text: What happens to your brain after ten hours completely alone?

scenes.headline: NO CONTACT
scenes.text: In a study published in Nature Neuroscience, people spent ten hours in a room with no social contact and no phone.

scenes.headline: BRAIN SCAN
scenes.text: Afterwards, brain scans showed that a region deep in the midbrain lit up when they saw pictures of people having fun together.

scenes.headline: SAME REGION
scenes.text: The same region reacts to food when you're hungry.

scenes.headline: SOCIAL CRAVING
scenes.text: Researchers described it as social craving.

scenes.headline: LIKE HUNGER?
scenes.text: So when you feel lonely, your brain may be reading it like hunger.
